List all layer IDs from a MapLibre GL style.

list_layers.Rd

Fetches (if URL) or parses (if inline JSON) a MapLibre GL style and returns all layer id values. Also prints a two-column data.frame of id and type to the console for interactive exploration.

Usage

list_layers(style_input)

Arguments

style_input

Character: a MapLibre GL style URL or inline JSON string.

Value

A character vector of all layer id values.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ids <- list_layers("https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json")
} # }
